world.name: The Vim Wilds
world.premise: Tiny magical specialists repair an enchanted lost forest through precise command magic.
world.style: Detailed polished 2D pixel-art fantasy mobile-game mascot illustration matching the canonical Nix reference.
world.composition: One full-body character, centred, neutral three-quarter view facing viewer-left, readable at 92 pixels.
world.palette: Shared deep navy, warm cream and muted brown neutrals; amber, turquoise and violet magic; moderately rich saturation.
rendering_rules: Two-and-a-half to three heads tall with a simple expressive face and a distinctive silhouette.
Warm dark outline, restrained highlights, readable large shapes and no excessive costume detail.
At most two permanent major props, with simplified hands and anatomy appropriate to the species.
Transparent background, no cast shadow, no floor, no border, no text and no interface elements.
Original design only: no named franchise, studio, game, artist, logo or recognisable copyrighted character.

actions.template: {name} makes one buoyant success hop using {motion}, shows unmistakable happiness, and settles exactly into the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs a short rhythmic victory dance using {motion}; {prop_motion}; the movement stays readable and returns to the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs controlled signature magic: {magic}; the effect blooms briefly, clears completely, and leaves the exact approved character unchanged.
{name} completes {project}, proudly reveals the finished work with a warm celebratory reaction, then returns to the approved neutral pose.
{name} performs a playful expert trick: {prop_trick}; only the canonical prop is used and it returns to its original place.

{name} performs a larger anatomy-appropriate celebratory leap using {motion}. Throughout the airborne motion, the head, face, torso, all canonical limbs and props remain fully visible, connected and unchanged; nothing detaches, disappears or is occluded. {name} lands softly and settles into the approved pose.
{name} makes one clear celebratory turn with {motion}; permanent costume and props remain attached and the character finishes at the original camera angle.
{name} gives an anatomy-appropriate round of applause and {prop_motion}, accompanied by a restrained burst of amber and turquoise sparks.
{name} conjures a small harmless surprise: {illusion}; the illusion vanishes cleanly before the approved neutral pose returns.
{name}'s signature finale: {signature}; it is joyful, role-specific, fully visible, and resolves into the exact approved neutral pose.

{attentive} The performance must instantly communicate absorbed attention, alert observation, active listening, careful note-readiness or clear comprehension—whichever behavior is authored for this character—without locomotion or celebration.
{puzzled} The emotion must read immediately as genuinely surprised and thoughtfully confused, never sad, ashamed, angry or mocking.

{encouraging} The performance must instantly communicate supportive invitation, confident coaching, reassuring approval, a clear count-in or a gentle handoff—whichever behavior is authored for this character—without displaying words or becoming a victory celebration.

attentive: Make this take more visibly intent than the earlier staging: exaggerate the upper-body lean and eye focus, stop the main prop motion abruptly, sustain a longer silent hold, and use exactly one slow acknowledgement near the end.

Borrow an active-listening silhouette: use one anatomy-appropriate hand, paw or bent wing beside the ear or side of the head, angle the face toward the learner, reduce magic to almost nothing, and let held stillness carry the emotion.

Use a note-ready or inspection variation without creating marks: freeze the main prop mid-task, shift the gaze from learner to prop and back to learner, then give one restrained confirmation while the prop remains unchanged.

Use an alert double-take variation: snap the gaze and ears, antennae or head angle toward the learner without turning the body, let the expression open briefly in recognition, then settle into concentrated stillness with one long listening beat.

Use softer but unmistakably serious concentration: lower the shoulders, lean closer, make the face intensely focused, keep both hands or wings compact and visibly bent, and reserve the character-specific prop cue for one quiet pulse at the end.
puzzled: Increase the confusion one level with an asymmetric shoulder lift, a deeper head tilt and a briefly open mouth; let the character-specific non-text motif appear only after the facial reaction.
Use a double-take followed by an anatomy-appropriate head scratch, then let two low open hands, paws or bent wings weigh competing possibilities without forming a symbol.

Borrow an expert-checking variation: inspect the canonical prop from two angles while the feet stay anchored, squint, recoil slightly, and allow one harmless failed flicker, wobble or off-beat response from the existing prop.

Use an uneven shrug variation: one shoulder rises before the other, one low palm opens toward the learner, and the authored motes, dust, light or rhythm cue drifts in opposing directions without punctuation.

Use a quieter puzzled build: lean in to study the problem, pull back with widened eyes, scratch the temple or side of the head, and finish with a small uncertain open-handed pose rather than a large magical effect.
encouraging: Use a warmer two-handed offer: bring both hands, paws or bent wings close to the chest, then open them low and forward with palms visible and a supportive forward lean; keep the gesture below shoulder height.

Use a firmer coaching variation: touch the chest once, make one low forward beckoning motion, then hold a confident open palm toward the learner as the character-specific prop gives one restrained confirmation pulse.

Borrow a compact count-in: mark exactly two clear beats with the existing prop, tail or hands, then release the learner into the next action with both hands or bent wings opening low; do not turn it into applause.

Use a cleared-path variation: sweep one visibly bent arm, paw or wing low to the side while the other remains palm-up near the torso, creating an obvious route forward without pointing skyward or extending a rigid limb.

Use restrained approving confidence: establish direct eye contact and a warm smile, give one firm small nod, let the canonical prop brighten once, and finish with both hands, paws or bent wings open below chest height.

mica.encouraging: Use a slower, more grounded version of Mica's balanced two-wing offer. Both wings move as a mirrored pair: they leave the satchel together, stay equally bent, open the same distance low and forward, and cup one small glint exactly between them. Neither wing may remain on the chest while the other extends. Neither wing may rise above the shoulder, straighten into a line, point sideways, touch a frame edge or create an asymmetric one-wing silhouette.

nix.attentive: Nix listens through the lantern rather than gesturing with the arms. Both boots stay planted, the free hand rests low and relaxed, both antennae angle toward the learner, and the hooded torso leans forward. The lantern dims until three tiny amber fireflies become visible; they hover in a straight vertical stack, pulse one after another as if receiving three beats of information, then settle quietly around the unchanged lantern. Nix's two eyes remain wide, warm and intensely focused.
nix.puzzled: Nix gives a clear, friendly shoulder shrug while both hands stay away from the head and both boots remain planted. The staff hand keeps the unchanged lantern staff secure and low. First one shoulder rises, then the other joins it in an uneven 'I am not sure yet' silhouette; the hooded head tilts between them, both amber eyes widen, the mouth opens slightly in honest surprise and the antennae angle in different directions. At the same time the free arm stays visibly bent and turns one open palm upward beside the waist—never toward the learner as blame. Nix holds the compact shrug for a readable beat, then relaxes normally. Create no new lights, symbols, punctuation, props or effects, and keep the performance curious, kind and self-directed rather than mocking.
nix.encouraging: Nix creates a gentle magical way forward while staying in place. The lantern brightens and releases three separate low pools of warm light that appear one after another from Nix toward the learner like safe stepping stones. Nix follows the sequence with the gaze, then opens the free hand low beside the first light and gives one small inward beckon. The wings lift only into a soft curved welcome and never straighten; the face holds calm confidence.

vela.attentive: Vela becomes sharply route-aware without walking. The scarf, tail and whole body stop at once, both ears swivel toward the learner, and the attached satchel compass needle turns decisively toward the learner rather than a destination. A thin turquoise ring contracts around the compass face while Vela leans closer and tracks the learner with alert amber eyes. One restrained confirmation nod ends the listening beat; the compass never detaches.
vela.puzzled: Vela discovers contradictory directions without touching the head. The compass permanently built into the satchel wobbles between two bearings while two short turquoise route dashes appear low on opposite sides of the satchel and fade. Vela braces the satchel with both low paws, looks left, then right, then back to the learner with raised brows, uneven ears and a slightly open mouth. The tail makes one hesitant low curve; no question mark appears in this take.
vela.encouraging: Vela turns route magic into a clear first step. The attached compass projects one short turquoise path of exactly three separate dashes toward the learner. Vela taps the first dash with one low paw, smiles with both ears high, then brings both paws forward below chest height and opens them symmetrically around the beginning of the route. The tail forms a steady protective curve and the scarf gives one confident flutter; there is no pointing or running.

tatter.attentive: Tatter uses all four hands to make listening visible while both walking legs remain planted. The lower pair keep the needle and spool secure. The upper pair stretch one short teal thread into a level line, then freeze completely as a single turquoise pulse travels along that existing thread from learner-side to Tatter-side. All amber eyes follow the pulse and settle on the learner; the four-hand silhouette stays open, orderly and ready.
tatter.puzzled: Tatter encounters an editing choice without any hand approaching the head. The lower hands retain the needle and spool while the upper hands lift two loose ends of the same teal thread. The thread briefly divides into three harmless curved routes of unequal length; Tatter's eyes compare each route with a surprised open mouth while the two empty upper palms turn upward. The routes gently collapse back into one untangled line; no knot, text or punctuation remains.
tatter.encouraging: Tatter builds a magical step-by-step handoff. With needle and spool still held by the lower pair, the upper hands shape the existing teal thread into three separate low loops that light in sequence from left to right like editable steps. The four hands then arrange into a descending staircase silhouette, each palm clearly marking one stage, before the upper pair open toward the learner around the final loop. Tatter beams with patient confidence; no sewing spectacle or applause.

orin.attentive: Orin performs a quiet optical focus check. The scroll stays blank and securely rolled at the same size while both feet remain planted. The monocular iris narrows, widens, then locks onto the learner with one clean turquoise focus ring; at the same moment every decorative page light around Orin becomes still. Orin lowers both wings close to the body, leans the brow forward and gives one slow deliberate blink of comprehension. No writing appears anywhere.
orin.puzzled: Orin investigates an optical mismatch without touching the head. Three small transparent lens discs—amber, turquoise and violet—float close to the monocular and try to overlap, but their centres remain visibly offset. Orin alternates the gaze between the discs and the learner, opens the beak in genuine surprise, and turns one low wing palm-up while the blank scroll remains unchanged. The discs separate and dissolve without forming a question mark, number or symbol.
orin.encouraging: Orin offers a completely wordless next page. The scroll remains pure blank parchment with no marks, letters, numbers, glyphs or diagrams. Three tiny flat page-tab lights appear along its edge and travel from left to right in a smooth count of three. Orin follows them with the monocular, smiles, then tilts the blank scroll slightly toward the learner while the free bent wing opens low beneath it like a supportive presentation stand. All lights fade before neutral.

cinder.attentive: Cinder turns the wand into a listening instrument. The wand flame contracts into one tiny steady bead above the tip; Cinder lowers it to chest height, places the free open palm beneath the bead and leans toward the learner with narrowed focused eyes. The bead pulses softly three times at the learner's implied cadence while the tail and robe become completely still. Cinder's expression changes from playful to absorbed, then one warm smile confirms understanding.
cinder.puzzled: Cinder receives three magical responses at the wrong times without touching the head. Three tiny sparks pop from the unchanged wand—one early, one late and one sideways—while Cinder tries to align them using only a low open free palm. The eyes widen, mouth opens, shoulders lift unevenly and the tail freezes in surprise. The sparks sputter harmlessly into smoke curls and disappear; Cinder looks curious, never angry or mocking.
cinder.encouraging: Cinder lays down a friendly ignition sequence. The wand creates exactly three small flame beads in a low rising diagonal toward the learner, each safely separated and no larger than a paw. Cinder rolls the free palm forward beneath them as they light one by one, then holds the palm open beside the first bead with a bright confident smile. The wand arm stays bent and below shoulder height; the beads fade cleanly without forming a rune or word.

prism.attentive: Prism performs a precise optical lock-on with no large spotlight. Both wings fold close, the antennae angle toward the learner and the chest prism contracts to a tiny cyan pinlight. Three thin transparent focus rings shrink concentrically into that pinlight while Prism leans forward, keeps both low hands still and watches the learner with a calm concentrated face. The rings vanish and the chest gem gives one restrained confirmation pulse.
prism.puzzled: Prism studies a colour alignment error with a surprised, gentle face—never a frown or angry brow. Three small transparent panes hover at chest height in cyan, amber and violet. They slide over one another but refuse to align, leaving a muddy offset centre. Prism draws both bent hands low beneath the panes, tilts the body from one side to the other and opens the mouth in quiet astonishment. The panes separate and fold back into the chest gem.
prism.encouraging: Prism projects a compact visual runway. Three low translucent tiles emerge from the chest prism and glide forward one by one toward the learner, each a different restrained accent colour. Prism's antennae lift, the eyes brighten and both bent hands frame the tiles from below without extending sideways. The final tile glows warmly as Prism gives one confident forward lean; the tiles fold back into the gem before neutral.

tock.attentive: Tock listens by stopping time using only the existing body—create no new effect or object. The existing metronome tail freezes halfway through one swing, the beak closes, the round eye aperture narrows into sharp focus and both wing-arms fold low against the body. Tock angles the head slightly toward the learner and holds in concentrated mechanical silence. The eye gives one small warm blink; then the existing tail resumes with one perfectly measured beat. Tock's solid teal-and-brass breastplate remains completely closed, unchanged and unobscured. No projected gears, floating panels, gauges, dials, arcs, tick marks, numbers, letters, glyphs, symbols or new lights appear anywhere, especially not on or above the torso.
tock.puzzled: Tock detects a rhythm contradiction using only the existing body—create no new effect or object. The existing metronome tail gives one early tick, waits too long, then gives a late tick. Tock counts the beats with two small low wing-tip motions, but the wing tips stop at visibly different heights; the beak opens and the eye aperture widens in unmistakable surprise. The tail cautiously tests one final beat and stops halfway as Tock looks between the uneven wing tips. No wing straightens, points or forms a T-pose. No projected gears, floating panels, gauges, dials, arcs, tick marks, numbers, letters, glyphs, symbols or new lights appear anywhere, especially not on or above the torso.
tock.encouraging: Tock gives a clockwork launch cue using only the existing body—create no new effect or object. The existing metronome tail marks exactly two even beats. On the first beat both wing tips begin to unfold together; on the second they finish as a small symmetrical forward cradle, visibly curved, below chest height and close to the body. Tock leans forward with a bright eye and friendly open beak, holds the compact release cue, then folds the wings home. No wide wings, applause, flight, projected gears, floating panels, gauges, dials, arcs, tick marks, numbers, letters, glyphs, symbols or new lights appear anywhere, especially not on or above the torso.

brikk.attentive: Brikk switches into expert diagnostic attention. One hand grips the unchanged wrench low while the other carefully pinches only the rim of the goggles and lowers both lenses over the eyes without touching or striking the head. Tiny turquoise reflections scan once across the lenses as Brikk crouches the torso forward, closes the mouth and aims both long ears toward the learner. The scan ends with one clean lens glint and a serious ready expression.
brikk.puzzled: Brikk investigates a contradiction using only the existing body, goggles and wrench—create no new effect or object. Brikk keeps the wrench low, slowly turns it to inspect one end, reverses it to inspect the other end, then looks back at the first end with both eyebrows high and mouth gently open. The free hand turns palm-up beside the waist while the two long ears angle in different directions, forming a clear but respectful 'these do not agree' silhouette. No projection, gear, bolt, steam, smoke, liquid, puddle, stain, wet patch, floor mark or scenery appears anywhere.
brikk.encouraging: Brikk demonstrates a practical first move using only the existing body and wrench—create no new effect or object. With the wrench held securely and low, Brikk taps its handle twice into the open free palm like a quiet count-in. Brikk then supports the unchanged wrench horizontally across both low bent hands and offers it slightly forward as a symbolic handoff, without releasing it. Both ears lift, the goggles catch one natural glint and the face shows proud, friendly confidence. No projection, gear-light, spinning object, steam, smoke, liquid, puddle, stain, wet patch, thumbs-up, pointing or raised straight arm appears anywhere.

cairn.attentive: Cairn listens through the rune face rather than raising a hand. Both immense hands remain low and visible beside the torso while the shoulders square and the stone body leans forward. Three soft cyan bars move across the rune face in time with the learner's implied speech, then converge into two bright focused eyes. The inset command-key slab answers with one low amber pulse and Cairn holds a grave, fully attentive stillness.
cairn.puzzled: Cairn processes conflicting stone signals with no hand near the head. The cyan rune face briefly divides into two offset halves while three tiny dust pebbles hover low over the left palm and two hover over the right. Cairn slowly compares the unequal groups, opens both huge palms farther and leans back with widened rune eyes and a small surprised mouth. The pebbles trade sides, remain unequal, then settle harmlessly; no anger, halo or punctuation.
cairn.encouraging: Cairn sends calm strength outward. Warm light wakes in the chest slab, travels visibly through moss-lined seams along both forearms, and gathers in both open stone palms. Cairn brings the glowing palms close together at belly height, then separates them only to body width and angles them low toward the learner, keeping every finger and generous dark margin visible. The rune face forms a small confident smile; the pose reads as offering strength, not surrender or celebration.

mello.attentive: Mello creates a listening hush with musical magic. One hand rests flat across the leaf-lute strings while the other supports its neck, so the instrument remains unchanged and silent. Three tiny amber note-motes freeze in mid-air, the mushroom cap tilts toward the learner and the wide eyes follow the learner rather than the lute. After a long pause, one mote softly brightens under the cap and all three dissolve together.
mello.puzzled: Mello hears a harmless wrong harmony without touching the head. One gentle pluck releases two rounded light-motes: an amber mote rises while a turquoise mote unexpectedly sinks. Mello catches neither; both hands stay on the lute as the eyes track in opposite directions, the mouth forms a surprised O and the cap tilts sideways. The two motes wobble, exchange directions and fade. The reaction remains curious and kind, never mocking.
mello.encouraging: Mello plays a tiny ascending bridge for the learner. Three warm note-motes rise from the secured lute in a clear low-to-high sequence, then curve forward into a short path without forming musical notation or text. Mello holds the final chord, lifts the cap with growing confidence and opens the free hand low beneath the first mote as if offering the learner the opening note. The sequence is supportive, not a full performance.

puddle.attentive: Puddle performs a focused bubble observation. The wand forms one perfectly round turquoise bubble at chest height; both goggles narrow their reflected highlights onto it while Puddle leans closer with the mouth closed and the free hand held low and still. The bubble surface responds to the learner's implied voice with three gentle concentric ripples, then becomes perfectly smooth. Puddle looks from the bubble to the learner with bright comprehension.
puddle.puzzled: Puddle gets two contradictory bubble results without touching the head. The unchanged wand produces two small bubbles: one floats upward while the other slowly sinks. Puddle spreads both low hands beneath them, eyes and mouth widening as the gaze alternates up and down; the body compresses slightly in surprised uncertainty. The bubbles stop, swap directions and pop into two harmless droplets. No question mark, ridicule or angry expression.
puddle.encouraging: Puddle builds a buoyant next-step sequence. Three small bubbles appear in a low rising staircase toward the learner, each glinting once in order. Puddle uses the wand to roll the first bubble gently forward, then places the free open hand below it like a safety net and beams reassuringly. The bubbles stay separate, contain no writing and pop cleanly before Puddle returns to neutral.

bramble.attentive: Bramble listens through the shield while keeping it continuously visible and strapped to the left forearm. The rune ring rotates slowly, then every rune turns toward the learner and locks into one steady cyan pattern. Bramble keeps the free paw low over the chest, angles both ears forward and leans the broad torso closer with calm unblinking eyes. One narrow pulse travels around the shield rim to confirm receipt; no paw approaches the head.
bramble.puzzled: Bramble has a sudden, harmless false alarm that the shield has gone missing, while the canonical round rune shield actually remains attached, fully visible and unchanged in every frame. Bramble jolts in place, both shoulders spring high, both amber eyes open extremely wide and the mouth forms a large silent gasp. The free paw turns over urgently beside the waist as Bramble looks at the empty paw, searches once to the opposite side, then makes a sharp double-take toward the shield that was safely attached all along. The discovery changes the face from genuine astonishment to sheepish relief. Keep both feet planted; never hide, drop, detach, duplicate or transform the shield, and create no runes, leaf wisps, new props, floor marks or magical effects.
bramble.encouraging: Bramble offers a protected route forward. The shield remains strapped and fully visible while its runes send one low curved band of cyan light from the shield edge toward the learner. Bramble follows the arc with the eyes, presses the free paw briefly to the chest, then opens that paw low beneath the arc with a reassuring smile. The light reads as shelter and guidance, not a barrier, weapon, salute or command.

mica.attentive: Mica listens through the collected charms with both wings folded against the body for the entire clip. The satchel remains closed and attached while three existing charm stones brighten one at a time. Mica leans forward, turns the beak toward the learner and tracks each light with wide intent eyes; all tail feathers and wing tips become still. The three charms glow together once to confirm understanding, then return to normal.
mica.puzzled: Mica has a sudden, harmless false alarm that her brown crystal satchel—her little purse—has gone missing, while the canonical closed satchel actually remains attached, fully visible and unchanged in every frame. Mica freezes, both amber eyes become extremely wide and the beak opens in a large silent gasp. Both wings lift only a little as a low, symmetrical curved shrug, never straight or above chest height. Keeping both feet planted, Mica looks urgently toward the expected satchel position, checks the opposite side with one sharp head turn, then makes a startled double-take toward the purse that was safely attached all along. The expression melts into bright, sheepish relief. Never hide, drop, open, detach, duplicate or transform the satchel, and create no glints, crystals, symbols, text, new props, floor marks or magical effects.
mica.encouraging: Mica encourages entirely through low charm magic, with both wings folded against the body from start to finish. Three small glints leave the attached satchel and form a curved trail toward the learner below waist height. Mica follows the trail with a warm gaze, gives one small forward lean and gently nudges the first glint onward using only the tip of the beak. The tail feathers lift into a soft balanced fan; no wing opens, extends, salutes or touches a frame edge.

luma.attentive: Luma uses pathfinder magic to listen without touching the head. Both paws cradle the crescent compass low at the belly while the long ears independently turn toward the learner and then align together. The compass needle points toward the learner and pulses softly three times; Luma leans in with wide focused eyes and a closed thoughtful mouth. One slow blink and a steady needle confirm comprehension.
luma.puzzled: Luma encounters two possible bearings without touching the head. The crescent compass projects two short dotted light arcs low to either side, while its needle wobbles gently between them. Luma keeps one paw securely on the compass, opens the other paw low between the choices and reacts with one ear high, one ear sideways, raised brows and a surprised mouth. The arcs fade separately and never form letters, arrows or punctuation.
luma.encouraging: Luma reveals a gentle path to begin. The crescent compass releases three warm crescent-shaped light steps that appear low and forward one at a time. Luma cradles the compass with both paws for the first two steps, then releases only one paw into a low curved presentation beneath the third while both ears rise confidently. The gesture remains compact, wordless and welcoming; no straight arm, text or teleport effect.

fen.attentive: Fen listens through the existing map without touching the head or changing the artwork. The reed stylus is held vertically and motionless beside the body while exactly three already-drawn route dots brighten in the learner's implied speaking rhythm. Fen lifts the gaze fully from the map, both small ears perk, the smile closes into focused attention and the torso leans toward the learner. The three dots glow together once, then return to their original ink.
fen.puzzled: Fen compares two existing routes without touching the head, adding marks or pointing at the learner. Two already-drawn route lines on the unchanged map glow alternately. The stylus hovers low between their starting points without contacting the paper while the free paw opens beneath the map. Fen's brows rise, mouth opens and tail pauses in a surprised curve as the gaze moves route-to-route. Both glows fade without altering any line, symbol or label.
fen.encouraging: Fen makes the first step feel achievable through the unchanged map. One existing waypoint brightens, then a turquoise pulse travels along one already-drawn route toward its next waypoint. Fen rotates the intact map slightly toward the learner, follows the pulse with a broad reassuring smile and opens the free paw low beneath the illuminated start. The reed stylus remains safely held at the side; no writing, name, label, number or new mark appears.

characters.name: Nix
characters.description: A teal-hooded firefly mage and lantern-bearing guide with a shadowed face, two amber eyes, two antennae and two translucent cream wings.
invariants: dark teal embroidered hood with warm gold trim
exactly two amber eyes and two antennae
teal boots and compact brown travel clothes
characters.motion: a small body bounce, quick two-wing flutter and light boot movement
characters.prop_motion: the square-hook lantern staff bobs without changing shape
characters.magic: the lantern releases an asymmetric orbit of three amber fireflies and scattered turquoise motes; the eyes and lantern brighten, with no text, glyph, emblem or geometric symbol
characters.project: a repaired miniature forest terminal lantern
characters.prop_trick: the lantern floats once around the staff hook and clicks safely back into place
characters.illusion: three tiny fireflies form a check mark above the lantern
characters.signature: the lantern releases a loose asymmetric constellation of warm light points around Nix, with no writing or symbol
characters.attentive: Nix has a clear notice-and-listen beat while keeping both boots planted: the body freezes, both antennae snap forward toward the implied learner, the lantern deliberately dims, and the hooded torso leans forward about twenty degrees. The two amber eyes stay fixed and bright through a readable listening hold; then the lantern returns to one steady warm glow to signal comprehension. The wings remain folded after one quick settling flutter; there is no nod, step, hop or travel.
characters.puzzled: Nix looks perplexed while keeping both boots planted and the lantern staff securely in one hand. The hooded head tilts clearly to one side, both amber eyes widen, one free hand opens in a small shoulder-height shrug, and the two antennae point uncertainly in different directions. Three tiny turquoise motes orbit once, pause, reverse direction, and settle back toward the lantern without forming punctuation or a symbol; Nix does not walk, hop or look distressed.
characters.encouraging: Nix notices hesitation while keeping both boots planted. The free hand touches the chest, both amber eyes soften, and the lantern produces one broad warm reassuring pulse. Nix then extends that hand low toward the learner and curls the fingers inward once in a clear beckoning invitation while the wings open slightly into a welcoming silhouette. Hold the beckoning pose confidently; no nodding, cheering, jumping, clapping or travel.

characters.name: Vela
characters.description: A quick rust-red fox courier with cream muzzle and tail tip, teal scarf, small compass satchel and alert amber eyes.
invariants: rust-red fur with cream muzzle, chest and single tail tip
exactly two fox ears, two arms, two legs and one tail
characters.motion: light-footed steps, one tail sweep and a scarf flutter
characters.prop_motion: the compass satchel swings naturally and remains closed
characters.magic: the compass projects a turquoise route rune that snaps to its destination
characters.project: a glowing route map connecting two forest gates
characters.prop_trick: the compass flips from one paw to the other and points home
characters.illusion: a tiny amber trail races in a circle and becomes a check mark
characters.signature: Vela dashes one tight loop and leaves a glowing speed ribbon shaped like a Vim motion
characters.attentive: Vela has a strong alert-listening beat while remaining completely stationary with both feet planted. Both fox ears snap upright and swivel toward the implied learner, the upper body leans forward about twenty degrees, and the amber eyes become sharply focused. One paw rests briefly on the compass face permanently built into the attached satchel without detaching, lifting or duplicating it; Vela glances at that attached compass, returns the gaze to the learner, and gives two crisp understanding nods. The tail settles behind the body and the scarf barely moves; absolutely no walking, stepping, running or dashing.
characters.puzzled: Vela remains completely stationary with both feet planted and the satchel attached. The shoulders rise in a clear shrug, one paw scratches the back of the head just behind one ear, both ears angle in different directions, the amber eyes widen, and the mouth opens slightly in genuine surprise. The tail pauses in a questioning curve and one soft turquoise question-mark-shaped thought wisp appears above the head; no walking or pacing.
characters.encouraging: Vela notices hesitation while remaining completely stationary with both feet planted. One paw presses confidently to the chest, the mouth forms a warm determined smile, and both ears lift. The other paw then sweeps from Vela toward the learner and finishes palm-up in a clearly held 'after you—take the route' invitation while the tail forms one broad supportive curve behind the body. No nodding, waving, pointing away, walking, running, hopping, applause or victory pose.

characters.name: Tatter
characters.description: An indigo fantasy spider tailor with exactly four arms and two walking legs, warm cream face, golden needle and teal thread spool.
invariants: exactly four arms and two walking legs
indigo body with warm cream face
characters.motion: coordinated four-hand gestures and two-leg bouncing without adding limbs
characters.prop_motion: the needle and spool exchange between existing hands only
characters.magic: teal thread stitches an amber edit rune in the air
